messages:
alex_devex: Quick one — new user ran the 'app-starter' quickstart and on their very first API call they got redirected to the billing UI asking for a credit card. They said they signed up with a trial and free credits. Is this expected?

morgan: hmm, not expected for trials. Which quickstart link did they use? web or local docker?

alex_devex: local npm starter. Steps: `npm run start` then open localhost and hit the sample endpoint that calls /v1/generate. It failed with a 402-style redirect to billing. They attached a screenshot.

jin: does the request include an org header or workspace id override? We gate by workspace if org has no billing configured.

alex_devex: They said they were on a fresh workspace created from invite. No org-level billing set. Thought trial should let first calls through until credits exhausted.

morgan: @jin can you check quickstart's client lib? There was a change last month that makes the client prefer workspace token over org token; maybe that triggers billing check earlier.

jin: I'll look. Can you DM me the user's workspace id? I want to find the server logs.

billing-bot: noticed: workspace wks_01F7ABCD had 0 billingMethod and trial_credits=100. Last attempt by jwt_... returned 403 with body: `{ "error": "billing_required", "action": "redirect_account" }` at 2026-03-23T15:02:10Z.

sam_ops: We recently tightened gating for private quickstarts to avoid abuse. That rule might be misfiring for trial workspaces created via invites.

alex_devex: user says they created workspace via invite link from teammate (not via self-serve signup).

morgan: ah — invite flow creates a workspace meta record but doesn't attach trial credits automatically unless the inviter's org passed a flag. That could explain billing_required. But it shouldn't redirect the API call in the sample app; it should return an informative 402 JSON so the sample app can show the billing CTA.

devex_intern: Repro steps from the user: 1) invite user to workspace 2) accept invite 3) clone app-starter 4) set ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY: `sk_live_...` 5) curl `POST /v1/generate` -> 302 to /billing/setup. I can try to reproduce locally.

jin: If it's a 302 redirect, that's coming from the console web middleware, not the API. The SDK should surface a 402 JSON, not a 302. That implies the sample app is following redirects automatically (axios/fetch) and hitting console UI.

alex_devex: oh interesting — the sample app does `fetch('/api/proxy/generate')` which proxies and follows redirects by default. We should tweak proxy to not follow and surface the error to UI.

morgan: good find. Quick fix options: a) update app-starter to check `response.redirected` or b) set fetch option `redirect: 'manual'` and handle 3xx -> show billing CTA.

jin: I'm going to check runtime logs to confirm whether API returned JSON or console returned redirect.

billing-bot: confirm: backend /v1/generate responded 402 with `{type: 'billing_required', code:'billing_required'}` at 2026-03-23T15:02:09Z. The web proxy then forwarded user-agent and got a 302 from /console/billing/setup.

sam_ops: So two bugs: SDK/sample-app UX follows redirects and shows console page; and invite-created workspaces aren't being auto-provisioned with trial credits reliably. Both need fixes but different owners.

alex_devex: Proposed immediate action: update sample app to detect `redirected` or `redirect:'manual'` and show a clear message: "Billing required — workspace has no payment method. Invite the admin or set up billing." Add a note in quickstart README.

morgan: I'll open a small PR for the sample app. @jin can you add an internal ticket to investigate the invite -> trial provisioning mismatch? Put me as reviewer for the PR.

jin: Yup. I'll create INC/BUG-2026 with logs + repro steps. Also adding an API contract test to assert APIs always return JSON error bodies and not HTML redirects when called by the SDK.

devex_intern: I'll add a unit test for the sample app fetch flow to assert `redirect: 'manual'` handling.

alex_devex: thanks y'all. Leaving the user's screenshot and workspace id in the ticket. Will ping if they still see it after the app patch. :thumbsup:
